title: 2026 product roadmap
goal: Show a quarterly product roadmap from discovery through general availability.

rubric.must: Four visible tracks labelled Q1, Q2, Q3, and Q4 organize the 2026 roadmap.
Private beta, Public beta, and General availability are visibly emphasized milestones in Q2, Q3, and Q4.
The quarter tracks and dated events read in chronological order from January through December 2026.
Customer discovery and architecture approval are visible before core workflow build and private beta.
Reliability hardening is visibly scheduled before General availability.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: Image 1 satisfies all five rules with four labeled quarter tracks, chronological dated events, and emphasized milestones, while image 2 omits required events and milestones.
